record.question: The right atrium receives blood from:
options: Inferior vena cava and Jugular vein
Superior vena cava and Jugular vein
Inferior vena cava and superior vena cava
record.explanation: Answer C: Inferior vena cava and superior vena cava. The right atrium receives systemic venous return directly from the superior and inferior venae cavae and the coronary sinus. Of the listed pairs, the SVC and IVC pair is correct. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK607442/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
